Text.Text: I am Sergeant Rhun of the outpost militia, which is me and eleven people who would rather be somewhere warm. If you have come to tell me the Byysk are a problem, I already know.
Here is your pay from the militia chest. With the adepts gone, the stronghold is open to anyone hard enough to walk into it. Ask me how to get inside when you are ready.
You are back. The warbands hit the wall last night and nobody froze. Did you kill all five Byysk Cryo Adepts?

It is worse than the warbands you can see. Behind them is a stronghold in the Qion Hive that I cannot reach with twelve people, but its officers come out. They are called Cryo Adepts, and they freeze my line where it stands so the warriors can walk in. I need you to kill five Byysk Cryo Adepts, then come back to me here.
Good. Kill five Byysk Cryo Adepts in the Frozen Caves or the Qion Foothills, then come back to me here at the Hutlar Outpost. Do not stand still near one.
A Cryo Adept is a Byysk who throws cold the way you would throw a grenade. I cannot tell you if it is a machine or a gift, but I lost three people learning that it is real.
They are in the Frozen Caves and the Qion Foothills, in among the ordinary warriors. They stand at the back, so look for the one the others are protecting.
You still owe me five dead Byysk Cryo Adepts. They are in the Frozen Caves and the Qion Foothills, behind the ordinary warriors. Come back when you have killed all five.
That is the first chamber cleared. Here is your pay. The Shaman waits in the second chamber, and he is stranger, so ask me about him when you are ready.
You are back alive, and I would not have bet on that. Is the Byysk Champion dead?

You go through the Qion Hive. The approach is thick with Byysk Guardians, and past them stands the ziggurat, where the chieftain keeps three locked chambers between himself and the world. The first belongs to his Champion, who carries the key to the next one. I need you to kill the Byysk Champion in the ziggurat, then come back to me here.
Good. Go into the ziggurat in the Qion Hive and kill the Byysk Champion, then come back to me here. Take his key, because you will need it for the next chamber.
You will have to fight through them to reach the ziggurat. Sharene will pay you for every Guardian you kill, so speak to her first if you have not already.
Each of them holds the key to the next chamber. The Champion has the Shaman's key, and the Shaman has the chieftain's. It keeps their rivals out, and it keeps us out too.
You still need to kill the Byysk Champion. He is in the ziggurat in the Qion Hive, and he carries the key to the Shaman's chamber. Come back to me when he is dead.
The stronghold itself comes next, but I will not send you there while the adepts are still freezing my line. Kill the five Byysk Cryo Adepts first.
Then their teacher is gone, and that is two chambers cleared. Here is your pay. Only the Chieftain is left, so ask me about the last chamber when you are ready.
You are back, and no new adepts have come at the wall this week. Is the Byysk Shaman dead?

The Shaman is in there, and the Champion's key opens his chamber. He is the one who trains the Cryo Adepts, and whatever they do with cold, he does better. He also holds the key to the chieftain's chamber. I need you to go back into the ziggurat in the Qion Hive and kill the Byysk Shaman, then come back to me here.
Good. Kill the Byysk Shaman in the second chamber of the ziggurat in the Qion Hive, then come back to me here. Take the chieftain's key from him.
Keep moving and finish the fight fast, because the longer it goes, the slower you get. That is all I know. Nobody who fought him has come back to tell me more.
You still need to kill the Byysk Shaman. He is in the second chamber of the ziggurat in the Qion Hive. Come back to me when he is dead.
The Shaman comes next, but he is behind the chamber door that the Champion's key opens. You have to kill the Byysk Champion first.
I waited two winters for that. Here is all the militia chest can spare, and keep the Chieftain's Torc you took from him. The clans will understand it. Ask me what he was guarding.
You are back. The warbands pulled back into the foothills at dawn, all at once, without a shot. Is the Byysk Chieftain dead?

The Chieftain is in there. Every warband that has come at this outpost came on his word, and he has never needed to leave the ziggurat. Without him the Byysk are clans again instead of an army. I have waited two winters to give this order. I need you to kill the Byysk Chieftain in the last chamber, then come back to me here.
Good. Kill the Byysk Chieftain in the last chamber of the ziggurat in the Qion Hive, then come back to me here. The Shaman's key opens his door. Good luck, and I mean it.
They will stop being organized. A clan raids a trap line, but an army burns an outpost. I will gladly take the clans over the army.
Expect everything the Champion and the Shaman had, and his personal guard besides. Take people with you, because this is not a fight to take on alone.
You still need to kill the Byysk Chieftain. He is in the last chamber of the ziggurat in the Qion Hive. Come back to me when he is dead.
The Chieftain comes next, but the Shaman holds the key to his chamber. You have to kill the Byysk Shaman first.
Tunnels mean that something is digging them, and I was afraid of that. Here is your pay. Ask me about the diggers when you are ready to go back down.
You are back, and you have a look about you. Did you kill all twelve Qion Hive Slugs, and what is down there?

He carried a key to a door behind his own chamber. Past it is the Outer Hive, and it holds pale slugs that come straight at you, not Byysk. I think the Byysk built the ziggurat to keep something in. I need you to go into the Outer Hive and kill twelve Qion Hive Slugs, then come back and tell me what you saw.
Good. Kill twelve Qion Hive Slugs in the Outer Hive, past the Chieftain's chamber in the Qion Hive, then come back to me here. Tell me what else you see down there.
Nobody puts three locked chambers and their best fighters in front of nothing. Whatever is past that door, the Byysk thought it was worth guarding with their lives.
You still owe me twelve dead Qion Hive Slugs. They are in the Outer Hive, beyond the ziggurat in the Qion Hive. Come back when you have killed all twelve.
Still ground is good. Here is your pay. The diggers will be replaced unless you kill the thing that lays them, so ask me about that next.
You are back, and the power crews say the ground has been still for three days. Did you kill all twelve Qion Hive Tunnelers?

The power crews have felt the ground shift under the structures for a year and blamed the ice. It is Tunnelers, digging outward from the Outer Hive, and one of those tunnels will come up under something we need. I need you to go into the Outer Hive and kill twelve Qion Hive Tunnelers to buy me time. Come back to me when it is done.
Good. Kill twelve Qion Hive Tunnelers in the Outer Hive of the Qion Hive, then come back to me here. They come out of the walls, so watch the walls.
I need time to find out what they are digging toward, or what is telling them to dig. Killing diggers only slows them down until I know that.
You still owe me twelve dead Qion Hive Tunnelers. They are in the Outer Hive of the Qion Hive. Come back when you have killed all twelve.

Then the Hive is sealed. The militia chest is empty, so the outpost took up a collection for you. Take this Broodguard Ring too, cut from her shell. The Byysk guarded her for generations, and now you have.
You are back. The slugs on the tundra have stopped moving toward the Hive, as though nothing is calling them. Is the Qion Hive Broodmother dead?

A Broodmother lies at the very bottom of the Qion Hive, past the Outer Hive, and everything pale down there came out of her. The Byysk held her there for longer than this outpost has existed, and we killed the people doing it. Now it is our job. I need you to kill the Qion Hive Broodmother, then come back to me here.
Good. Kill the Qion Hive Broodmother at the bottom of the Qion Hive, past the Outer Hive, then come back to me here. End her, and nothing digs under this outpost again.
We made it our problem. I would do it again, because the Chieftain was burning us out. But I owe the Byysk an apology that I will never get to make.
I do not know, because nobody has ever done it. Take everyone you trust down there with you, and do not go alone.
You still need to kill the Qion Hive Broodmother. She is at the heart of the Qion Hive, beyond the Outer Hive. Come back to me when she is dead.
The thing that lays them comes next, but I need the digging slowed first. Kill the twelve Qion Hive Tunnelers before you ask me about it.
Hold the wall, Sergeant. I will be back.
What else is the militia dealing with?
Yes, all five Cryo Adepts are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will kill five Byysk Cryo Adepts.
Not right now. That is the militia's fight.
What exactly is a Cryo Adept?
Where do I find the Cryo Adepts?
How bad is the Byysk problem?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Cryo Adepts.
Yes, the Byysk Champion is dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will kill the Byysk Champion.
Not right now. Three chambers is three too many.
What should I do about the Byysk Guardians?
What is this key the Champion carries?
How do I get into the Byysk stronghold?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Byysk Champion.
What comes after the Cryo Adepts are dead?
Yes, the Byysk Shaman is dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will kill the Byysk Shaman.
Not right now. I have gone far enough.
How do I fight someone who uses cold?
What is in the second chamber of the ziggurat?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Byysk Shaman.
What comes after the Byysk Champion?
Yes, the Byysk Chieftain is dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will kill the Byysk Chieftain.
Not right now. You should find an army.
Will the Byysk stop attacking if he dies?
What should I expect in his chamber?
What is in the last chamber of the ziggurat?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Byysk Chieftain.
What comes after the Byysk Shaman?
Yes, all twelve are dead, and I saw a great many tunnels.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will kill twelve Qion Hive Slugs.
Not right now. I have seen enough of the Hive.
Why do you think they were keeping something in?
What was the Chieftain guarding in the ziggurat?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Hive Slugs.
Yes, all twelve Tunnelers are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will kill twelve Qion Hive Tunnelers.
Not right now. I am not going back down.
What do you need the time for?
What is digging tunnels under the ice?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Tunnelers.
Yes, the Broodmother is dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will kill the Broodmother.
Not right now. That is too deep for me.
Did we make this worse by killing the Chieftain?
How do I kill the Broodmother?
What is laying the Tunnelers?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Broodmother.
What comes after the Tunnelers?
